The store was Pine Crossing. I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message.

- **Where it came from:** Pree posted it in #central-team on Jun 9. The morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 a.m. had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he would check the shift template.
- **What's missing:** I found no address, city or site code for Pine Crossing in anything Pree can see, so I couldn't give her more than the store name for the sheet.
- **A mismatch:** Pine Crossing isn't one of the six store names on the onboarding ticket SUP-5102 (North Creek, Elm Junction, Prairie Bend, Mill Crossing, West Ridge, South Fork). I suggested she check with the customer's store operations team before updating the sheet.

Nothing in the reply needed approval.
